title: Roasted Mexican Tacos
description: A flavorful and spicy Mexican-inspired taco recipe made with roasted chicken, topped with fresh cilantro, sour cream, and salsa.
instructions: Season chicken breasts with tacos seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until fully cooked.
While the chicken is cooking, roast peppers in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
Sauté the onion and garlic in a pan over medium heat until softened.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by placing a piece of chicken on each tortilla, followed by roasted peppers, onion, and garlic.
Top each taco with a dollop of sour cream, a sprinkle of cilantro, and a spoonful of salsa.
